name: Breña Alta (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Breña Alta within branches (a cross and crossed keys above a dragon tree on green).
history: Municipal flag of Breña Alta; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
